description: This file defines a React component for managing selected calendar settings, including rendering connected calendars, toggling calendar inclusion, and handling calendar connection/disconnection actions within a user interface.

methods.name: SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper
methods.description: Main React component that displays connected calendars, allows adding/removing calendars, and handles calendar connection status.

methods.name: SelectedCalendarsSettingsHeading
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering the header section with conflict check and calendar addition options.

methods.name: PlatformDisconnectIntegration
methods.description: Component providing functionality to disconnect a calendar integration, with confirmation modal and toast notifications.

methods.name: PlatformCalendarSwitch
methods.description: Component for toggling individual calendar inclusion, handling state and API calls for add/remove actions.

methods.name: PlatformAdditionalCalendarSelector
methods.description: Dropdown component allowing users to add new calendars from Google, Outlook, or Apple integrations.
